prompt: What information are you able to provide regarding the ESP32-C-Mini and what is your cut off date
response:
The ESP32-C-Mini is a compact version of the ESP32 series of microcontrollers developed by Espressif Systems. It is designed to be a smaller, more integrated solution for IoT (Internet of Things) applications, offering Wi-Fi and Bluetooth connectivity in a very small form factor. The ESP32-C-Mini is particularly useful for projects where space is at a premium but full ESP32 functionality is required.

Key features of the ESP32-C-Mini include:

- Dual-core 32-bit Tensilica LX6 microprocessor running at 240 MHz
- Integrated Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n) and Bluetooth (BLE) connectivity
- Low power consumption
- A wide range of GPIOs (General Purpose Input/Output pins)
- Support for various communication protocols such as I2C, SPI, UART, and more
- On-chip flash memory and PSRAM for data storage and processing
